title: Not for use in oven.
text:
Not for use in oven.. I bought these to use for baking pizzas in the oven. Pizzas cook more evenly when on cardboard vs pan.
Smells bad when baked on in the oven.

product_metadata.title: MT Products Corrugated White Cardboard Cake Board or Pizza Circle 14 inch - Sturdy Cake Base for Displaying Cakes, Bread and Desserts (15 Pieces) - Made in The USA
features: SUPERIOR QUALITY: Made of quality corrugated cardboard, these round cardboard circles are strong and durable and are perfect for supporting heavy or lightweight cakes so you can easily insert them into a box. (Note: These are not grease-proof cake circles.)

BEAUTIFUL DISPLAY: These round cake boards are perfect for displaying your beautiful cakes and mouth watering treats for customers and clients. Arrange your tempting cakes and delicious treats on these cardboard cake boards for an eye-catching presentation.

PERFECT SIZE: This cardboard circle come in a variety of sizes to best suit your needs - from personal pies to medium sized cakes, our large variety of sizes has got you covered. Even though the platform is circular, these cake circle boards will accommodate even square cakes.
FREEZE ‘EM: Perfect for rolling and making pizza on, these pizza circles are great for preparing and then freezing your personal pies on. Freeze homemade pizza on these cake boards for future use.

VARIETY: These cake board rounds are great for many different fun projects! Use them as a “canvas” for painting, arts and crafts activities to make a wheel or eyes of a puppet, or even as a beautiful centerpiece for the table at weddings, parties, or special events.
